independence.notes: Only French colony to vote 'Non' in 1958 referendum; Sékou Touré's defiance

natural_resources.notes: World's largest bauxite reserves (~7.4B tonnes, 25% of global total); first/second global producer; Simandou iron ore (world's largest undeveloped deposit, Rio Tinto/Winning Consortium, $15B+ project); hydropower potential enormous (Fouta Djallon highlands, 'water tower of West Africa'); gold mining growing rapidly

military.notes: September 2021 coup (Col. Mamady Doumbouya ousted Alpha Condé); junta in power; left ECOWAS 2024 (with Mali/Burkina); French military cooperation reduced; historically politicized military (Sékou Touré used military for repression); ethnically divided forces

infrastructure.notes: Orange, MTN Guinea; poor road conditions especially in rainy season.

debt_aid.notes: Mining revenue transforming economy; Simandou iron ore project could double GDP; Chinese/Russian investment growing post-coup; HIPC debt relief beneficiary; Sékou Touré's socialism impoverished the nation, still recovering

education.notes: Low literacy (45%); French-language instruction; Sékou Touré era had ideology-driven education; enormous gender gap; Ebola 2014-15 closed schools for months; Quranic schools significant in Fouta Djallon

diaspora_migration.diaspora_population: 700,000 (France ~40k, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Liberia, Sierra Leone, USA)
diaspora_migration.notes: Sékou Touré regime drove massive exile (1/3 of population fled 1958-84); Mandinka/Fulani trade networks span West Africa; Ebola stigma affected migrants; 'backway' migration to Europe through West Africa-Libya-Mediterranean route

digital_economy.notes: Limited digital infrastructure; Orange Guinea dominant; mobile money growing from low base; internet shutdowns during political crises; mining sector IT adoption; Saboutech incubator emerging

country_profile.notes_unique: First French-speaking African country to gain independence (1958) after voting 'No' in de Gaulle's referendum; holds the world's largest bauxite reserves.

geography.terrain: Coastal plain; mountainous Fouta Djallon interior; forested Guinea Highlands in southeast; Niger River basin in northeast
geography.notes: Source of Niger, Gambia, and Senegal rivers — 'Water Tower of West Africa'; Mont Nimba UNESCO site; world's largest bauxite reserves.

economy_extended.notes: World's largest bauxite reserves (~25% global); Simandou iron ore mega-project; mining-dependent; Sept 2021 military coup (Col. Doumbouya).

health.notes: Ebola epidemic epicenter (2013-2016, ~3800 deaths); weak health infrastructure; community health workers program.

food_agriculture.notes: Rice main staple; fonio (ancient grain) specialty; Fouta Djallon cattle herding.

energy.notes: Kaléta dam (240MW, 2015); Souapiti dam (450MW, 2021, China-funded); vast hydro potential; most rural areas lack electricity.

major_airports_international: Conakry Ahmed Sékou Touré International Airport
transport.notes: Port of Conakry handles bauxite exports; Trans-Guinean Railway project (Simandou); poor road network.

unesco_sites_list: Mount Nimba Strict Nature Reserve (shared with Côte d'Ivoire)
tourism.notes: Tourism potential largely untapped; Fouta Djallon trekking; political instability deters visitors.

human_rights_gender.notes: Highest FGM rate globally (~95%); Sept 2021 military coup; suspended constitution; ECOWAS sanctions.

security_stability.notes: Military junta since Sept 2021 (Col. Mamadi Doumbouya); transition timeline uncertain; ECOWAS suspended; protest crackdowns.

notable_historical_figures: Ahmed Sékou Touré (1st president, said 'No' to De Gaulle)
Miriam Makeba (exiled singer, lived in Guinea)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: State RTG dominates; some private FM stations; media restricted under junta
cultural_heritage.notes: Djembe drum originated here; Sékou Touré's 'No' to France (1958) iconic independence moment; rich music tradition.

legal_system.notes: 2020 constitution (Alpha Condé term extension) suspended by junta; transitional charter in force; new constitution promised.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
